## Semantic delta

Describe added, removed, or reordered loop nodes; classification changes; status changes; and any visualization or translation updates.

## Collaboration checks

- [ ] I fetched or read the latest target branch before editing.
- [ ] I checked the remote head again before publishing this pull request.
- [ ] Same-item conflicts are resolved or explicitly listed below.
- [ ] Progress overview, open decisions, change log, visualizations, and translations are synchronized.
- [ ] The IO Flow validator passes at the appropriate strictness.

## Conflicts or deferred decisions

List unresolved same-item conflicts and the decision owner. Do not use last-write-wins for product semantics.
